o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: Events with governed Case_ID / eligible events
o2cDataQualityGates.Acceptance Threshold: ≥95% for eligible digital O2C events; unresolved events remain in orphan queue
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: Blocks E4 if failed; E3 may remain for traceable sampled cases
o2cDataQualityGates.Failure Handling: Investigate broken parent references; never fuzzy-match certified lineage

o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: Duplicate Event_ID count after governed retry normalization
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: Blocks certified E3/E4 dataset if duplicates affect business sequence
o2cDataQualityGates.Failure Handling: Separate legitimate technical retries from duplicate ingestions

o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: Core events with Event_Timestamp / core events
o2cDataQualityGates.Acceptance Threshold: ≥98% for core milestones; 100% for events used in cycle-time KPI
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: KPI-specific publication blocked when required timestamp is missing
o2cDataQualityGates.Failure Handling: Flag missing source history; do not impute event time from ingestion time

o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: Cases without impossible event order / cases checked
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: Blocks affected cycle-time/variant KPI; sampled cases may remain E3 with exception
o2cDataQualityGates.Failure Handling: Check timezone/source-clock issue before classifying process defect
o2cDataQualityGates.Notes / Source URL: Workbook timezone set to Asia/Dhaka; retain source UTC/offset where available

o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: Extracted record/event counts and financial totals vs source control totals
o2cDataQualityGates.Required Fields / Inputs: Source_System; source counts; amount/qty control totals
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: Blocks E4 publication until unexplained gaps are resolved
o2cDataQualityGates.Failure Handling: Classify extraction filter, timing, failed ingestion or source inconsistency

o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: Eligible child documents with explicit governed parent / eligible child documents
o2cDataQualityGates.Acceptance Threshold: ≥95% overall; target 100% for finance-critical invoice/payment relations
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: Blocks end-to-end E4 reconciliation if below threshold
o2cDataQualityGates.Failure Handling: Retain orphan queue with owner and age; do not drop unmatched records

o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: Ordered/authorized vs delivered/invoiced/returned line quantities within approved tolerance and split rules
o2cDataQualityGates.Required Fields / Inputs: Document_Line_ID; Item_ID; Quantity; UOM; document bridge
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: Blocks partial-fulfilment and return E4 KPI when material mismatches remain
o2cDataQualityGates.Failure Handling: Separate planned split, undelivered balance, return and true mismatch

o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: Quantity events with valid UOM and approved conversion where common reporting is required
o2cDataQualityGates.Acceptance Threshold: 100% for quantity events used in aggregated KPI
o2cDataQualityGates.Required Fields / Inputs: Item_ID; Quantity; UOM; conversion table; organization
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: Blocks aggregated quantity KPI when incompatible UOM is unresolved
o2cDataQualityGates.Failure Handling: Never aggregate MT/KG/RFT/piece without governed conversion
o2cDataQualityGates.Notes / Source URL: Known AGI unit transitions require effective-dated mapping

o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: Invoice/receipt/credit amounts reconcile to authoritative BC ledger within documented timing/currency rules
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: Blocks finance KPI E4 if unexplained variance exists
o2cDataQualityGates.Failure Handling: Use BC as financial authority for posted events; keep app values as operational context

o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: Human/control events with attributable user/service identity / eligible events
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: Blocks Human Dependency E4 if identity coverage is insufficient
o2cDataQualityGates.Failure Handling: Do not classify a shared account as one individual; remediate audit weakness separately
o2cDataQualityGates.Notes / Source URL: Internal audit / Sales Eco actor-evidence requirement

o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: Events used in STP/Human Touch metrics with non-Unknown Execution_Type / eligible events
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: Blocks STP/Human Dependency E4 when below threshold
o2cDataQualityGates.Failure Handling: Mandatory approval remains Human; technical retry remains Integration, not extra business touch

o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: Integration-driven events with usable Correlation_ID / integration-driven events
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: Does not block all E3 evidence, but blocks certified retry/root-cause KPI when below threshold

o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: In-scope transaction rows resolved to valid Organization/Customer/Item/RC/location mapping
o2cDataQualityGates.Required Fields / Inputs: Organization; Customer_ID; Item_ID; RC; Location_Code; effective dates
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: Blocks segmented E4 KPI where unresolved mapping affects denominator/numerator
o2cDataQualityGates.Failure Handling: Quarantine unresolved or cross-organization mapping errors

o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: Completed digital deliveries with terminal POD or explicit exception / completed digital deliveries
o2cDataQualityGates.Acceptance Threshold: 100% terminal state for pilot scope; POD completeness rule varies by SBU/channel
o2cDataQualityGates.Required Fields / Inputs: Case_ID; DO/DN; delivery attempt; POD/exception state; timestamp
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: Blocks POD Capture / delivery-cycle E4 KPI when terminal coverage is incomplete
o2cDataQualityGates.Failure Handling: Missing proof stays in denominator and issue queue
o2cDataQualityGates.Notes / Source URL: Internal Logistics PRD/SDD; live deployment evidence required

o2cDataQualityGates.Formula / Logic: Cases satisfying approved closure rule / cases classified closed
o2cDataQualityGates.Acceptance Threshold: 100% of published closed cases meet approved rule
o2cDataQualityGates.Required Fields / Inputs: Case_ID; document chain; payment/return state; reconciliation status
o2cDataQualityGates.Evidence-Level Impact: Blocks O2C end-to-end cycle E4 if closure rule is not deterministic and reproducible
o2cDataQualityGates.Failure Handling: Closure rule must explicitly handle partial payment, returns/credits and approved exclusions

states.Name: Manual / Fragmented
states.Definition: Work is performed through paper, spreadsheets, email, phone, memory or disconnected tools.

states.Name: Digitized / System of Record
states.Definition: Process is captured in an approved system with structured data and traceability.
states.Important Guardrail: Digitized does not mean automated or adopted.

states.Name: Workflow / Rules Automated
states.Definition: Deterministic validations, routing, calculations, integrations and approvals are automated.

states.Name: AI-assisted / Copilot
states.Definition: AI recommends, summarizes, predicts or detects anomalies while humans retain decision authority.
states.Important Guardrail: Require evidence quality, explainability and human accountability.

states.Name: Agent-operated with Human Approval / Supervision
states.Definition: Agent performs multi-step execution but material decisions/actions require human approval or active supervision.
states.Important Guardrail: Use only where controls, observability and rollback are adequate.

states.Name: Agentic / Autonomous within Guardrails
states.Definition: Agent autonomously executes an approved bounded process and escalates exceptions.
states.Important Guardrail: Not a universal target. Safety, financial, legal and control-critical processes may optimally stop at S2-S4.

evidenceLevels.Name: No evidence
evidenceLevels.Minimum Evidence Standard: Statement, assumption or undocumented claim only.
evidenceLevels.Use in Management Reporting: Do not use as maturity fact.

evidenceLevels.Name: Design evidence
evidenceLevels.Use in Management Reporting: Shows intended design, not actual execution.

evidenceLevels.Name: Build / configuration evidence
evidenceLevels.Minimum Evidence Standard: Working build, configuration, test environment, UAT artifact, integration proof or prototype.
evidenceLevels.Use in Management Reporting: Shows capability exists; adoption/production outcome not proven.

evidenceLevels.Name: Production execution evidence
evidenceLevels.Minimum Evidence Standard: Production transactions/logs demonstrate process is live and repeatedly executed.

evidenceLevels.Name: Outcome / adoption evidence
evidenceLevels.Minimum Evidence Standard: Usage/adoption metrics, cycle-time, exception, quality or productivity outcomes demonstrate operational value.

evidenceLevels.Name: Controlled / audited evidence
evidenceLevels.Minimum Evidence Standard: Sustained outcomes plus verified control effectiveness, audit trail, governance and exception handling.
evidenceLevels.Use in Management Reporting: Highest confidence for autonomous/agentic operating-state claims.
